title: A completion form distinguishes bounded events from ongoing procedures
summary: A narrow aspectual model assigns a completion form to bounded events with an endpoint and leaves ongoing procedures without that form until an endpoint is introduced.

design.unit: paired procedure records with the same operation and input but differing endpoint/completion status
design.prediction: The completion form should occur only when a terminal state is explicitly reached; adding an endpoint changes the form while leaving operation identity fixed.
design.countermodel: A context-conditioned lexical convention or editorial packaging could produce the same surface distribution without the proposed semantic mechanism.
design.falsifier: The form appears in ongoing procedures with no endpoint, or endpoint-bearing records systematically lack it under matched operation/input.
design.principal_risk: Endpoint status is not independently available. Related to operation/result and completion routes; this draft tests endpoint licensing, not a specific lexical result word.
